spans.s:
1 A bundle, bunch (in
general).
--2 A bunch of flowers, a
cluster of blossoms, a clump (of
trees &c.); अक्ष्णोर्निक्षिपदंजनं
श्रवणयोस्तापिच्छगुच्छावलिं

.
--3 The plumage
of a peacock.
--4 A necklace of pearls
(in general).
--5 A pearl necklace
of 32 (or, according to some, of 70)
strings.
--Comp.
--अर्धः a pearl
necklace of 24 strings.
--(र्धः, --र्धं) half of
a cluster.
--कणिशः a kind of corn.
--पत्रः the palm tree.
--फलः {1} the
vine. {2} plantain tree.
